content:
Hi everyone,

I opened #14040 a few weeks ago and it hasn't been reviewed yet, so I wanted to gently bump it here. It fixes a panic in simp +ground that failed with an "unknown constant _inhabitedExprDummy" error (closes #12620).

It's a small, self-contained change. Would anyone with the relevant context be willing to take a look?

Thanks!

Your issue and PR received priority labels from the triage team. We generally don't accept PRs to critical subsystems like the simplifier from external contributors, which is why the PR received the P-low priority label, indicating that we're not planning to look at this. The issue itself received the P-medium priority label, meaning that we agree that it is worth fixing but don't see a reason to prioritize it over the countless other issues which are worth fixing.

Thanks for explaining. I understand the reasoning, but this policy isn't written down anywhere - and it should be. Nothing in CONTRIBUTING.md indicates that some subsystems don't accept external PRs.

The P-medium read as "worth fixing, but not worth our limited time", which seemed like exactly the case where an outside contribution helps. One sentence in the guide would have saved me the work, and would save the next person too.

Michał Dobranowski schrieb:

which seemed like exactly the case where an outside contribution helps.

Usually, reviewing an outside contribution is not much less work than fixing it ourselves. For very small PRs this may be different, and your is very small and has a test case (so that’s good). It is very likely that whoever looks at #12620 will also look at your PR, and may just use it as it.
